items.title: Weekly SME IT Update — 2 June 2026
items.content_html:
The SME tech landscape is shifting again, and a few trends are worth keeping an eye on if you run or manage a business relying on cloud services, Microsoft 365, or hybrid infrastructure.

🔐 Security first: ransomware tactics are changing

Attackers are increasingly skipping encryption altogether and going straight for data theft and extortion. That means traditional “we have backups” thinking isn’t enough anymore.

  • Strong identity protection
  • MFA everywhere
  • Reviewing vendor and third‑party access
  • Tightening email security

☁️ Cloud costs are quietly rising

Azure, AWS, and Google have all made incremental pricing changes across storage, egress, and GPU workloads. Nothing dramatic individually, but it adds up.

🛡️ Microsoft is pushing secure‑by‑default

More services are moving to enforced MFA, improved Conditional Access templates, and automated patching.

🌐 VPN appliances are becoming a liability

Legacy VPN boxes continue to be a favourite target for attackers. If you’re still relying on one, it’s worth considering a move toward Zero Trust or modern cloud‑based access solutions.

If you want to talk through any of these changes — or you’re wondering what they mean for your business — I’m always happy to help.
items.summary: Ransomware tactics are shifting, cloud costs are rising, and Microsoft continues its secure‑by‑default push. Here’s what SMEs need to know this week.
